## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector breadth is positive while Big Tech is broadly weak (AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND), and leadership is Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), supporting a neutral, mixed market.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND and strong sector performance (Materials 1W: +16.20% | 1M: +17.33%). Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -14.43%) BELOW TREND and NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND; Financials mixed/soft: BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND vs JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials/Industrials showing strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communications/Materials and select Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W momentum: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND — watch DD as an outlier for mean-reversion risk given extreme move; no Major Divergence signal from core mega-caps but monitor big-cap breadth.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is weak with negative 1W/1M and broad underperformance: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) BELOW TREND and ACN (1W: -19.35% | 1M: -28.92%) BELOW TREND — sector showing weakness and internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed to soft: JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.24%) ABOVE TREND offset by BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth slightly negative (Financials 1W: -0.33% | 1M: +3.88%), so expect selective leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is constructive: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND while PFE (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%) BELOW TREND is the main lag — sector showing relative strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain neutral positioning: favor Materials and Healthcare exposure (DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND) and Industrials (CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech/Communication names showing broad weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NFLX). Monitor DD and AMAT for momentum exhaustion and XOM for news/price divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -19.35% | 1M: -28.92%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +16.20% | 1M: +17.33%) Sector Strength, Healthcare (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.61%) Sector Strength, Industrials (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +12.13%) showing upside. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -3.66%) Sector Weakness, Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -1.14%) and Communications (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.38%) at risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND — needs sustained weekly strength to signal trend change. AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND — watch for further deterioration vs. short-term support tests. ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND — monitor follow-through after approval news for continuation. DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND — treat as momentum outlier; watch for pullback.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABBV (+60): AbbVie wins Health Canada approval for Boey — price confirming (ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND). LLY (+80): EMA backing for Jaypirca — price confirming (LLY (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND). XOM (+60): Supreme Court decision revives Cuba claim — price diverging (XOM (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -8.18%) BELOW TREND), watch for news-driven mean reversion.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NFLX (-50): Technical rout and negative headlines — price confirming (NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND). ACN (-50): PT cut after Q3 report — price confirming (ACN (1W: -19.35% | 1M: -28.92%) BELOW TREND). AAPL (-45): Analyst downgrade headline — price confirming (AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials/Healthcare/Industrials leadership. ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND and CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is broad Big Tech weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND) and select news/price divergences (XOM bullish news but price BELOW TREND).
